| # Parameter Configuration on eC {#parameter-configuration-on-ec-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                              |                                                                                                              |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This topic explains the configuration of relevant parameters for LIN module in easyConfig.\
The following parameters can be configured from eC tool. Some parameters are directly updated from LDF file while the other mandatory parameters should be configured in easyConfig.

## Global Definition: {#global-definition .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

## 1. LIN Protocol Version {#lin-protocol-version .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ---------------------- --------------- ------- ------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------
  Parameter Name         Default Value   Range   Description                           Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  LIN Protocol Version   2.0             \-      Specifies the LIN Protocol version.   Yes                  It is unmodifiable.
  ---------------------- --------------- ------- ------------------------------------- -------------------- ---------------------

 

2\. Baud Rate (for RC18-12/40, RC27-18/40)

  ---------------- --------------- -------------- --------------------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------------------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range          Description                                   Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Baud Rate        19200           1000 - 20000   Specifies the baud rate of the LIN channel.   Yes                  It should be configured by the user.
  ---------------- --------------- -------------- --------------------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------------------------

3\. Goto Sleep Frame Counter

  -------------------------- --------------- ------- ------------------------------------------------------ -------------------- --------------------------------------
  Parameter Name             Default Value   Range   Description                                            Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Goto Sleep Frame Counter   3               1 - 5   Specifies the number of LIN sleep frames to be sent.   Yes                  It should be configured by the user.
  -------------------------- --------------- ------- ------------------------------------------------------ -------------------- --------------------------------------

## 4. Break Length {#break-length .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ---------------- --------------- --------- ------------------------------------------ -------------------- --------------------------------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range     Description                                Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Break Length     13              13 - 20   Specifies the Sync Break Length in bits.   Yes                  It should be configured by the user.
  ---------------- --------------- --------- ------------------------------------------ -------------------- --------------------------------------

## 5. Cycle Time {#cycle-time .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

+----------------+---------------+--------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------+
| Parameter Name | Default Value | Range        | Description                                                                           | Mandatory (Yes/No) | Other remarks                        |
+----------------+---------------+--------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------+
| Cycle Time     | 10            | 5 ms / 10 ms | Specifies the Cycle Time with which LIN communication stack operates in milliseconds. | Yes                | It should be configured by the user. |
|                |               |              |                                                                                       |                    |                                      |
|                |               |              | Delay time of configured LIN frame should be a multiple of Cycle Time.                |                    |                                      |
+----------------+---------------+--------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+--------------------------------------+

## Frame details: {#frame-details .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

## 1. User Callout {#user-callout .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  ---------------- --------------- ------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------------------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range   Description                                                                                                                                                                Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  User Callout     \-              \-      By providing a function with the specified callout name further functionalities can be defined by the user. This function is called every time a new PDU is transmitted.   No                   It should be configured by the user.
  ---------------- --------------- ------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------------------------

 

## Frame details\' configuration specific for RC18-12/40, RC27-18/40: {#frame-details-configuration-specific-for-rc18-1240-rc27-1840 .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

2\. Timeout Period

  ---------------- --------------- ------------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------------------------
  Parameter Name   Default Value   Range              Description                                                                Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Timeout          0               0 - 3600 seconds   Defines the length of the deadline monitoring timeout period in seconds.   No                   It should be configured by the user.
  ---------------- --------------- ------------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------------------------

## 3. Error Notification {#error-notification .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  -------------------- --------------- ------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------------------------
  Parameter Name       Default Value   Range   Description                                                                                                                                                                Mandatory (Yes/No)   Other remarks
  Error Notification   \-              \-      By providing a function with the specified callout name further functionalities can be defined by the user. The function is called every time a PDU timeout is detected.   No                   It should be configured by the user.
  -------------------- --------------- ------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------- --------------------------------------
